plugin.name: Status_Effect_Tracker
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Resizable themed status-effect tracker with escalating alerts
plugin.description:
STATUS EFFECT TRACKER
Parses the status-effect snapshot line from the HP/MP readout, e.g.:
<<Protect Shell Regen >> <<None>>
Beneficial effects are shown in green. Harmful effects are shown in red. Unknown effects are shown neutrally.
Alert escalation: 0 harmful: normal 1 harmful: highlighted only 2 harmful: flashing border/title + 1 ALERT 3 harmful: faster flashing + 2 ALERTs 4 harmful: 3 ALERTs 5+ harmful: progressively more ALERTs, capped for readability
Commands: statuswin show statuswin hide
Shared themes: theme default theme classic theme amber
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
Win = GetPluginID()
-------------------------------------------------- -- CONFIG --------------------------------------------------
WINDOW_WIDTH = 195 WINDOW_HEIGHT = 193
TITLE_HEIGHT = 22 ROW_HEIGHT = 20
FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" BODY_FONT_SIZE = 9 TITLE_FONT_SIZE = 9
INSET = 8
MAX_ALERT_WORDS = 6
-------------------------------------------------- -- RESIZABLE MINIWINDOW --------------------------------------------------
RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE = 14 MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH = 165 MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT = 140 resizeActive = false
function LoadWindowSize() local w = tonumber(GetVariable("status_width")) local h = tonumber(GetVariable("status_height")) if w then WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) end if h then WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) end end
function SaveWindowSize() SetVariable("status_width", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH))) SetVariable("status_height", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT))) end
function ResizeMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) resizeActive = true return 0 end
function UpdateResizeFromMouse() local mouseX = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 17)) local mouseY = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 18)) local left = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 1)) or 0 local top = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 2)) or 0 if not mouseX or not mouseY then return false end local newW = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(mouseX - left + 1)) local newH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(mouseY - top + 1)) if newW == WINDOW_WIDTH and newH == WINDOW_HEIGHT then return false end WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT = newW, newH WindowResize(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BACKGROUND) Redraw() return true end
function ResizeMouseMove(flags, hotspot_id) if resizeActive then UpdateResizeFromMouse() end SetCursor(miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow) return 0 end
function ResizeMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) if resizeActive then UpdateResizeFromMouse() end resizeActive = false SaveWindowSize() DrawWindow() return 0 end
function InstallResizeHandle() WindowDeleteHotspot(Win, "00_resize") local l = math.max(0, WINDOW_WIDTH - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE) local t = math.max(0, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE) WindowAddHotspot(Win, "00_resize", l, t, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, "", "", "ResizeMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(Win, "00_resize", "ResizeMouseMove", "ResizeMouseUp", 0) WindowLine(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH-11, WINDOW_HEIGHT-3, WINDOW_WIDTH-3, WINDOW_HEIGHT-11, C_BORDER or 0, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) WindowLine(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH-7, WINDOW_HEIGHT-3, WINDOW_WIDTH-3, WINDOW_HEIGHT-7, C_BORDER or 0, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- EFFECT TABLES --------------------------------------------------
positiveEffects = {
["Convalescence"] = true, ["Double"] = true, ["Haste"] = true, ["Killer"] = true, ["MP Regen"] = true, ["Permanence"] = true, ["Praise"] = true, ["Preach"] = true, ["Protect"] = true, ["Protectga"] = true, ["Reflect"] = true, ["Refreshment"] = true, ["Regen"] = true, ["Reraise"] = true, ["Sentinel"] = true, ["Shell"] = true, ["Shellga"] = true, ["Spellspring"] = true, ["Triple"] = true, ["Veil"] = true,
["Beast"] = true, ["Bubble"] = true, ["Counter Force"] = true, ["Dragon Force"] = true, ["Focus"] = true, ["Mighty Guard"] = true, }
negativeEffects = {
["Berserk"] = true, ["Blind"] = true, ["Curse"] = true, ["Engulf"] = true, ["HP Leak"] = true, ["Immobilize"] = true, ["Imp"] = true, ["Mini"] = true, ["Paralyze"] = true, ["Petrify"] = true, ["Poison"] = true, ["Provoke"] = true, ["Silence"] = true, ["Sleep"] = true, ["Slow"] = true, ["Stop"] = true, ["Trouble"] = true, ["Zombie"] = true,
["Dischord"] = true, ["Disease"] = true, }
-------------------------------------------------- -- BUILD SORTED NAME LISTS FOR LONGEST-FIRST PARSE --------------------------------------------------
allKnownEffects = {}
for name, _ in pairs( positiveEffects ) do
table.insert( allKnownEffects, name ) end
for name, _ in pairs( negativeEffects ) do
table.insert( allKnownEffects, name ) end
table.sort( allKnownEffects, function(a,b)
if #a == #b then return a < b end
return #a > #b end )
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEMES --------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "status"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
classic = {
background = "#000000", border = "#808080", title_bar = "darkslategray", title = "gold",
positive = "#55FF55", negative = "#FF5555", unknown = "#A0A0A0",
separator = "#282828",
alert_bright = "#FF3030", alert_dark = "#601010", alert_text = "#FFFFFF" },
amber = {
background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title = "#FFB347",
positive = "#7FFF7F", negative = "#FF5A3C", unknown = "#A8713A",
separator = "#2D1809",
alert_bright = "#FF3B22", alert_dark = "#5C1208", alert_text = "#FFD7A3" },
default = {
background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title = "#9AFF82",
positive = "#67FF67", negative = "#FF4D4D", unknown = "#5A8B5A",
separator = "#102A10",
alert_bright = "#FF3D3D", alert_dark = "#5A1010", alert_text = "#D7FFD7" } }
function LoadTheme()
local themeName = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[ themeName ] then
themeName = "default"
end
local T = THEMES[ themeName ]
C_BACKGROUND = ThemeColour("background", T.background)
C_BORDER = ThemeColour("border", T.border)
C_TITLE_BAR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar)
C_TITLE = ThemeColour("title", T.title)
C_POSITIVE = ThemeColour("positive", T.positive)
C_NEGATIVE = ThemeColour("negative", T.negative)
C_UNKNOWN = ThemeColour("unknown", T.unknown)
C_SEPARATOR = ThemeColour("separator", T.separator)
C_ALERT_BRIGHT = ThemeColour("alert_bright", T.alert_bright)
C_ALERT_DARK = ThemeColour("alert_dark", T.alert_dark)
C_ALERT_TEXT = ThemeColour("alert_text", T.alert_text) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- STATE --------------------------------------------------
windowinfo = ""
effects = {}
negativeCount = 0
flashOn = false
-------------------------------------------------- -- HELPERS --------------------------------------------------
function Trim(s)
if not s then return "" end
return s:match( "^%s*(.-)%s*$" ) or s end
function StartsWithEffect( text, effectName )
if text:sub( 1, #effectName ) ~= effectName then
return false end
if #text == #effectName then
return true end
local nextChar = text:sub( #effectName + 1, #effectName + 1 )
return nextChar == " " end
function ClassifyEffect(name)
if positiveEffects[ name ] then
return "positive"
end
if negativeEffects[ name ] then
return "negative"
end
return "unknown" end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PARSE STATUS SNAPSHOT --------------------------------------------------
function ParseStatusText( statusText )
statusText = Trim( statusText )
if statusText == "" or statusText == "None" then
return {} end
local result = {}
local remaining = statusText
while remaining ~= "" do
remaining = Trim( remaining )
local matchedName = nil
for _, effectName in ipairs( allKnownEffects ) do
if StartsWithEffect( remaining, effectName ) then
matchedName = effectName
break end
end
if matchedName then
table.insert( result, { name = matchedName,
kind = ClassifyEffect( matchedName ) } )
remaining = Trim( remaining:sub( #matchedName + 1 ) )
else
-------------------------------------------------- -- Unknown token fallback. -- -- Since unknown multi-word effects cannot be -- inferred safely, preserve one token at a time -- rather than guessing. --------------------------------------------------
local token, rest = remaining:match( "^(%S+)%s*(.*)$" )
if not token then break end
table.insert( result, { name = token,
kind = "unknown" } )
remaining = rest or "" end
end
return result end
function RecountNegatives()
negativeCount = 0
for _, effect in ipairs( effects ) do
if effect.kind == "negative" then
negativeCount = negativeCount + 1 end
end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- INPUT TRIGGER --------------------------------------------------
function OnStatusLine( name, line, wildcards )
local body = wildcards[1] or ""
-------------------------------------------------- -- Reject the HP/MP line and overall-condition line. -- The actual status snapshot contains neither of -- these markers. --------------------------------------------------
if body:match( "^HP:%s*%d+/%d+MP:%d+/%d+" ) then
return end
if body:find( "OVERALL CONDITION:", 1, true ) then
return end
effects = ParseStatusText( body )
RecountNegatives()
if negativeCount < 2 then
flashOn = false end
DrawWindow() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ALERT TIMER --------------------------------------------------
function StatusAlertTick()
if negativeCount < 2 then
if flashOn then
flashOn = false
DrawWindow() end
return end
flashOn = not flashOn
DrawWindow() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ALERT WORD COUNT --------------------------------------------------
function AlertWordCount()
if negativeCount < 2 then return 0 end
return math.min( MAX_ALERT_WORDS, negativeCount - 1 ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ESUNA BUTTON --------------------------------------------------
function UseEsuna( flags, hotspot_id )
Send("use whitemagic esuna") end
-------------------------------------------------- -- WINDOW DRAW --------------------------------------------------
function DrawWindow()
if not windowinfo then return end
WindowDeleteHotspot( Win, "status_esuna" )
local activeBorder = C_BORDER
local activeTitleBar = C_TITLE_BAR
local activeTitle = C_TITLE
if negativeCount >= 2 then
if flashOn then
activeBorder = C_ALERT_BRIGHT
activeTitleBar = C_ALERT_BRIGHT
activeTitle = C_ALERT_TEXT
else
activeBorder = C_ALERT_DARK
activeTitleBar = C_ALERT_DARK
activeTitle = C_ALERT_TEXT
end
end
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BACKGROUND )
-------------------------------------------------- -- TITLE BAR --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT, activeTitleBar )
local titleText = "STATUS"
if negativeCount >= 2 then
titleText = "STATUS ALERT" end
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, titleText, INSET, 4, WINDOW_WIDTH - INSET, TITLE_HEIGHT, activeTitle, false )
-------------------------------------------------- -- ESUNA BUTTON --------------------------------------------------
local buttonLeft = INSET
local buttonTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + 5
local buttonRight = WINDOW_WIDTH - INSET
local buttonBottom = buttonTop + ROW_HEIGHT + 4
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, buttonLeft, buttonTop, buttonRight, buttonBottom, C_SEPARATOR )
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, buttonLeft, buttonTop, buttonRight, buttonBottom, activeBorder )
local esunaWidth = WindowTextWidth( Win, "title"..Win, "Esuna" )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, "Esuna", math.floor( ( buttonLeft + buttonRight - esunaWidth ) / 2 ), buttonTop + 5, buttonRight, buttonBottom, C_TITLE, false )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "status_esuna", buttonLeft, buttonTop, buttonRight, buttonBottom, "", "", "", "", "UseEsuna", "Cast Esuna", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
-------------------------------------------------- -- EFFECT LIST --------------------------------------------------
local y = buttonBottom + 5
if #effects == 0 then
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, "None", INSET, y, WINDOW_WIDTH - INSET, y + ROW_HEIGHT, C_UNKNOWN, false )
else
for _, effect in ipairs( effects ) do
local colour = C_UNKNOWN
if effect.kind == "positive" then
colour = C_POSITIVE
elseif effect.kind == "negative" then
colour = C_NEGATIVE
end
WindowText( Win, "body"..Win, effect.name, INSET, y, WINDOW_WIDTH - INSET, y + ROW_HEIGHT, colour, false )
y = y + ROW_HEIGHT
if y > WINDOW_HEIGHT - 28 then
break end
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ESCALATING ALERT WORDS --------------------------------------------------
local count = AlertWordCount()
if count > 0 then
local alertY = WINDOW_HEIGHT - 20
local totalWidth = WINDOW_WIDTH - (INSET * 2)
local slotWidth = totalWidth / count
for i = 1, count do
local left = INSET + math.floor( (i - 1) * slotWidth )
local right = INSET + math.floor( i * slotWidth )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, "ALERT", left, alertY, right, WINDOW_HEIGHT, flashOn and C_ALERT_TEXT or C_NEGATIVE, false )
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- BORDER --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, activeBorder )
InstallResizeHandle() Redraw() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- INSTALL --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall()
LoadTheme() LoadWindowSize()
check( WindowCreate( Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, 0, 0, C_BACKGROUND ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "body"..Win, FONT_NAME, BODY_FONT_SIZE ) )
check( WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, TITLE_FONT_SIZE, true ) )
windowinfo = movewindow.install( Win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true )
check( WindowCreate( Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, C_BACKGROUND ) )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Explicit title-bar drag region. --------------------------------------------------
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT )
DrawWindow()
WindowShow( Win, true ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SAVE STATE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginSaveState()
SaveWindowSize()
movewindow.save_state( Win )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ENABLE / DISABLE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginEnable()
LoadTheme()
DrawWindow()
WindowShow( Win, true ) end
function OnPluginDisable()
WindowShow( Win, false ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- COMMANDS --------------------------------------------------
function statuswin_show( name, line, wildcards )
DrawWindow()
WindowShow( Win, true ) end
function statuswin_hide( name, line, wildcards )
WindowShow( Win, false ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEME BROADCAST --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then
return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then
return end
LoadTheme()
DrawWindow() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER LAYOUT API --------------------------------------------------
function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, winName, x, y) if type(info) ~= "table" then return end info.window_left = x info.window_top = y info.window_mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 7)) or info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left info.window_flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 8)) or info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() return Win end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= Win then return "wrong window" end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) SaveWindowSize()
WindowResize( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, C_BACKGROUND )
ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(windowinfo, Win, x, y) DrawWindow()
local mode = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left local flags = type(windowinfo) == "table" and windowinfo.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location WindowPosition(Win, x, y, mode, flags) if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(Win) end pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
